comment: AUTO-GENERATED from ascend.weather.mechanisms; do not edit by hand. variables/edges are the research graph projection.

declaration.slice_boundary: Unified weather field channels, continent/hydrology/tile algorithm pipelines, and dynamic biome subdivision ranges remain outside this slice; their outputs enter as declared boundary inputs.

weather.chunk.derive_seasonal_temperatur.equation: clamp(cold_endpoint - (annual_temperature - input_temp_min) / (input_temp_max - input_temp_min) * (cold_endpoint - hot_endpoint) + clamp((rain_reference - annual_rainfall) / rain_reference, -0.5, 1.0) * rain_bonus_scale, output_min, output_max)

weather.chunk.derive_solar_latitude_prox.equation: clamp(output_max - (sea_level_temperature - input_min) / (input_max - input_min) * (output_max - output_min), output_min, output_max)

weather.instant.compose_humidity.v1.equation: clamp(baseline + seasonal_offset + diurnal_offset + perturbation * perturb_scale, lower_bound, upper_bound)

weather.instant.compose_precipitation_in.equation: 0 if signal <= threshold else (min(signal, signal_max) - threshold) * intensity_scale * mean_intensity

weather.instant.compose_temperature.v1.equation: clamp(annual_temperature + seasonal_offset + diurnal_offset + perturbation * perturb_scale, lower_bound, upper_bound)

weather.instant.compose_wind_speed.v1.equation: clamp(clamp(baseline + perturbation * perturb_scale, lower_bound, upper_bound) * multiplier, lower_bound, upper_bound)

weather.offset.derive_seasonal_humidity..equation: seasonal_humidity_amplitude * (tanh(season_phase_cos * sharpness) if sharpness > 0 else season_phase_cos)

world.gen.classify_biome.v1.equation: 海洋按海面温度三档；陆地按气候档 + 细分维度三角隶属取主型（静态细分值域；大陆动态 subdiv_ranges 不在本切片）

world.gen.classify_climate_zone.v1.equation: 8 档静态决策树（C 单源，阈值由 config 经 hydrology 注入）

world.gen.derive_annual_mean_temperature.equation: sea_level_temperature - altitude * lapse_rate / 1000 for altitude > 0 else sea_level_temperature, clamp [-20, 36]（C 单源）

world.gen.derive_annual_rainfall.v1.equation: clamp(rainfall_min + (noise + 1) * 0.5 * (rainfall_max - rainfall_min), 0, 5000)（C 单源，min/max 由 config 注入）
